dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the shaded left lateral region and the more illuminated right dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark longitudinal linear mark located on the right side of the dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A significant longitudinal structural indentation is visible on the right side of the dorsal ridge, creating a localized shadow-cast.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent longitudinal scar or deep physical indentation on the right lateral-dorsal surface.
